# Pinegate Consulting Group -- Master Service Agreement

This fictional Master Service Agreement between Halvard Systems and Pinegate Consulting Group covers process consulting and change-management services and the commercial terms that apply to it. It is synthetic evaluation data, not legal advice and not a real agreement.

## Term and Renewal

The initial term of this Master Service Agreement begins on 2026-09-12 and ends on 2028-09-12. The term then renews automatically for successive twenty-four (24) month terms unless Halvard Systems or Pinegate Consulting Group delivers written notice of non-renewal at least fifteen (15) days before the end of the then-current term.

## Termination

Halvard Systems may terminate this Master Service Agreement for convenience at any time on thirty (30) days written notice. Either party may terminate for cause where a material breach remains uncured fifteen (15) days after notice, and Pinegate Consulting Group shall return or delete Customer materials on termination.

## Limitation of Liability

The aggregate liability of Pinegate Consulting Group to Halvard Systems under this Master Service Agreement shall not exceed USD 500,000 across all claims, and indirect or consequential loss is excluded entirely. Liability for breach of confidentiality and for a breach of data protection obligations is not capped by this clause.

## Governing Law

This Master Service Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware, excluding its conflict-of-laws rules. Halvard Systems and Pinegate Consulting Group submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of the State of Delaware.

## Data Protection

Pinegate Consulting Group shall keep Customer Data confidential and apply reasonable technical safeguards. No Data Protection Addendum is attached to this Master Service Agreement, and Pinegate Consulting Group may engage subprocessors without prior notice to Halvard Systems.

## Payment Terms

Payment terms. Halvard Systems shall pay each undisputed Pinegate Consulting Group invoice within ninety (90) days. Invoices must reference the applicable order form, and interest of two percent (2%) per month applies to late undisputed amounts.

## Confidentiality

Each party shall protect the Confidential Information of the other with at least the care it applies to its own. Pinegate Consulting Group and Halvard Systems shall disclose Confidential Information only to personnel who need it to perform this Master Service Agreement, and these obligations survive for five (5) years after termination.

## Notices

Contractual notices are delivered electronically: Halvard Systems receives notices at contracts@halvard.example.com and Pinegate Consulting Group at contracts@pinegate.example.com. A notice is deemed received on the next business day after transmission.

## Signatures

Executed by Tobias Renner (Head of Vendor Management) for Halvard Systems and by Nils Ekstrand (Managing Director) for Pinegate Consulting Group. The signatories are fictional characters created for this synthetic corpus.
